camel_example: aliyun cas ListCert --region cn-hangzhou --Status ISSUE --CurrentPage 1 --KeyWord test_name --SourceType aliyun --CertType CERT --ShowSize 50 --WarehouseId 12 --Identifiers 'aaa,bbb'
description_en: This API queries certificates in the certificate store
description_zh: 本接口一般用于查询证书仓库中的证书
kebab_example: aliyun cas list-cert --key-word test_name --warehouse-id 12 --status ISSUE --source-type aliyun --cert-type CERT --current-page 1 --show-size 50 --identifiers aaa,bbb --api-version 2020-04-07 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListCert

parameters.help_en: The keyword for a fuzzy search by name, domain name, or subject alternative name
parameters.help_zh: 查询关键字。支持通过名称、域名、SANS模糊查询
parameters.name: key_word

parameters.help_en: The warehouse ID. You can obtain this ID by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/453246.html API
parameters.name: warehouse_id

parameters.help_en:
The certificate status. Valid values:

ISSUE: issued

REVOKE: revoked
parameters.help_zh:
证书状态，取值：

ISSUE： 已签发
REVOKE： 吊销
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en:
The source of the certificate. Valid values:

upload: uploaded certificate

aliyun: Alibaba Cloud certificate
parameters.help_zh:
证书来源，取值：

upload：上传证书
aliyun：阿里云证书
parameters.name: source_type

parameters.help_en:
The certificate type. Valid values:

CA: CA certificate

CERT: issued certificate
parameters.help_zh:
证书的类型 。取值：

CA：表示CA证书。
CERT：表示签发的证书
parameters.name: cert_type

parameters.help_en: The page number to return. The default value is 1
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. The default value is 50
parameters.help_zh: 分页，每页展示数据大小，默认50条
parameters.name: show_size

parameters.help_en: A comma-separated list of certificate identifiers
parameters.help_zh: 证书标识，多个标识之间英文逗号间隔
parameters.name: identifiers

schema.description_en: A container for the response data

AfterDate.description_en: The expiration date of the certificate. This value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
AfterDate.description_zh: 到期时间。使用时间戳格式，单位为毫秒

Algorithm.description_en:
The encryption algorithm of the certificate. Valid values:

RSA: the RSA algorithm

ECC: the ECC algorithm

SM2: the SM2 algorithm
Algorithm.description_zh:
证书的加密算法类型。取值：

RSA：表示RSA算法。
ECC：表示ECC算法。
SM2：表示SM2（国密）算法

BeforeDate.description_en: The start date of the certificate's validity period. This value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
BeforeDate.description_zh: 签发时间。使用时间戳格式，单位为毫秒

CertType.description_en:
The type of the certificate. Valid values:

CA: a Certificate Authority (CA) certificate

CERT: an issued certificate
CertType.description_zh:
证书的类型 。取值：

CA：表示CA证书。
CERT：表示签发的证书

CommonName.description_en: The common name of the certificate. This is typically the primary domain name associated with the certificate

ExistPrivateKey.description_en:
Indicates whether a private key is available for the certificate. Valid values:

true

false
ExistPrivateKey.description_zh:
证书是否存在私钥。取值：

true
false

Identifier.description_en: The unique identifier of the certificate

Sans.description_en: The Subject Alternative Names (SANs) associated with the certificate. Multiple domain names are separated by commas (,)
Sans.description_zh: 证书绑定的所有域名。多个域名之间使用半角逗号（,）分隔

SerialNo.description_en: The serial number of the certificate. This parameter is returned only if the `OrderType` request parameter is set to `CERT` or `UPLOAD`
SerialNo.description_zh: 证书序列号，当入参OrderType=CERT或者UPLOAD时返回

SignAlgorithm.description_en: The signature algorithm of the certificate

SourceType.description_en:
The source of the certificate. Valid values:

upload: The certificate is uploaded.

aliyun: The certificate is from Alibaba Cloud
SourceType.description_zh:
证书来源，取值：

upload：上传证书
aliyun：阿里云证书

Status.description_en:
The status of the certificate. Valid values:

ISSUE: The certificate is issued.

REVOKE: The certificate is revoked
Status.description_zh:
证书状态，取值：

ISSUE：已签发
REVOKE： 吊销

ShowSize.description_zh: 分页，每页展示数据大小，默认50条
